summary: Internationalized domain names let Unicode names map into the DNS, but the same name can often be written in more than one way that people see as equivalent. These are often called variants. This informational document discusses variants in second-level names registered in top-level domains and the issues they raise for registries.

eli5.summary: One word can sometimes be spelled several ways that look the same to people. This talks about how name registries should handle those look-alike spellings.
